MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The lag bolt and small imperial screw assortments expand the fastening options in my recent metric bolt and rivet kits, making them useful for repair jobs with different fitting requirements.",
    "The O-ring kit and rubber wiring grommets offer practical repair functions alongside my drilling and fastening tools: replacing seals and protecting wires through drilled holes.",
    "Super glue fits the small repair work suggested by my tape and epoxy purchases, while tool storage feels relevant as my collection grows."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Concrete joint sealant assumes a specific project that my recent purchases do not establish; having repair supplies does not mean I currently need to seal concrete.",
    "Three construction adhesive cartridges and ten tiny glass syringes require a clearer immediate use than I have, even though bonding and dispensing are loosely related to supplies I own.",
    "The single-size countersunk screws are plausible, but I would need a matching project before choosing that particular diameter and length."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My adhesive purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in sealing and bonding products regardless of application or quantity.",
    "A broad connection to workshop repairs sometimes seems to stand in for whether an item fills a useful gap in my existing supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated assortment purchases suggest that having several usable sizes matters to me more than stocking one narrowly specified fastener without an immediate need.",
    "Quantity needs to fit the task: many fasteners in useful sizes appeal to me, but multiple adhesive cartridges or specialized dispensing tools need a specific reason.",
    "Fit affects my willingness to choose an item: grommet dimensions, screw sizes, and organizer mounting and capacity still need to suit my projects."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in practical repair supplies, but sometimes assumed specialized projects or quantities from a loose connection to tools and adhesives."
}
